note: Long-tail semantic discovery -- the 'neural precedent mining' workload (tools/kit.py:5). Queries are descriptive sentences, not keywords. Gold is a NON-EXHAUSTIVE set of hosts that genuinely qualify; scored by Recall@k over gold, so extra good results are never penalised. Exa runs type=neural here; TinyFish has no neural mode and runs its only mode. That asymmetry is the point of the suite: it measures OUTCOME (can it do the job), not mechanism.
